lead.headline: CYCLONE ARNAB APPROACHES ANDHRA COAST; EVACUATIONS BEGIN
lead.deck: Andhra Pradesh moves people from vulnerable areas as Odisha mobilises for an October 28 landfall

image.alt: Pregnant women being moved to hospital in Odisha as Cyclone Arnab approaches
image.caption: CYCLONE PREPAREDNESS: Authorities across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha are preparing for Cyclone Arnab, forecast to reach the coast on October 28. (Express Photo)

paragraphs: ANDHRA Pradesh has begun evacuations from vulnerable areas as Cyclone Arnab strengthens over the Bay of Bengal, with landfall forecast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on October 28.
Andhra officials have ordered evacuations from low-lying areas and moved 4,711 pregnant women to health centres and hospitals. Schools in the listed districts are to close from October 27 to 31.
The India Meteorological Department forecasts sustained winds of 115–125 km/h, with gusts up to 140 km/h. Odisha has also mobilised ministers and restricted fishing in vulnerable coastal districts.
Disaster-response teams are on standby as authorities issue public alerts and move residents to safer locations.

sidebarStory.headline: NAMMA METRO BLUE LINE TRIALS TARGET MONTH END
sidebarStory.subhead: KR Puram–Silk Board corridor is 87% complete; opening targeted for mid-2027

image.caption: Work continues on the Outer Ring Road Blue Line corridor. (Express Photo)

paragraphs: Trial runs on the 19.75-km K R Puram–Central Silk Board stretch are expected by the end of October. Construction is 87% complete, with station entry and exit works at 88%.
The corridor serves the Outer Ring Road IT hub and is targeted to open by mid-2027, subject to statutory clearances. Officials have also been told to remove barricades where work is complete.

stories.headline: HENNUR–BAGALUR ROADWORKS: PLAN ALTERNATE ROUTES
stories.subhead: Officials also call for wider footpaths wherever feasible

image.alt: Roadworks along the Hennur–Bagalur corridor in Bengaluru
image.caption: Roadwork planning on Bengaluru’s Hennur–Bagalur corridor.

paragraphs: Officials have been told to identify alternative routes before construction begins and provide wider footpaths wherever the road design allows.

stories.headline: 170 SPEEDING CASES BOOKED IN CITY DRIVE

image.alt: Scooter travelling on a Bengaluru road
image.caption: Traffic enforcement drive ran across all 53 city stations.

paragraphs: Between October 19 and 25, traffic police booked 170 overspeeding cases and collected ₹1.72 lakh in fines. Officers also checked 24,243 vehicles for drunk driving.

stories.headline: BENGALURU FORECAST: LIGHT RAIN, CLOUDY SKY

image.alt: Rain on a Bengaluru city road
image.caption: Rain on a Bengaluru road. (Representational image)

paragraphs: Monday: Cloudy with light rain; 27°C high and 21°C low, according to the IMD forecast.
Tuesday–Wednesday: Partly cloudy, with no weather warning shown for Bengaluru.

stories.headline: CENTRE CLEARS ₹2.12 LAKH CRORE DEFENCE ACQUISITIONS
stories.deck: About 82% of the procurement value is slated for Indian industry

image.caption: Surveillance and strike drones are among the approved systems. (File image)

paragraphs: The Defence Acquisition Council has cleared capital acquisition proposals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore for the Army, Navy and Air Force. Nearly 82% of the procurement is expected to come from Indian industry.
The approvals cover high-mobility vehicles, artillery, light helicopters, air-defence systems, surveillance equipment, drones and naval platforms.

stories.headline: COURT ACQUITS RAHUL GANDHI IN DEFAMATION CASE
paragraphs: A special MP-MLA court acquitted the Congress leader in an eight-year-old case over remarks about Amit Shah. The court found the complaint did not meet the legal threshold for defamation.

stories.headline: RULES UPDATED FOR E100 FLEX-FUEL VEHICLES
paragraphs: Amended motor-vehicle rules now expressly include E100 alongside E85 in emissions certification provisions. The change establishes a regulatory pathway for vehicles designed to run on high-ethanol blends.

stories.headline: FOUR RESCUED PUPPIES STILL NEED HOMES AFTER FIVE MONTHS
stories.deck: Blackie, Brownie, Rosie and Spots are waiting for permanent families

image.alt: Four rescued Bengaluru puppies available for adoption
image.caption: Four rescued puppies are still waiting for adoptive homes.

paragraphs: The four dogs have been in care for five months and are still looking for permanent homes. Their rescue story has drawn renewed attention to the city’s need for adopters and foster families.

stories.headline: TECH SUMMIT PLANS 50,000-SQ-FT ROBOTICS PAVILION

image.caption: Preparations are under way for Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026.

paragraphs: About 101 robotics and drone startups are expected at the summit, which will also feature live demonstrations and startup pitching.

stories.headline: PHYSICAL RTI REQUESTS NOW ENTERED ONLINE
paragraphs: Public authorities must register RTI applications received in person or by post on the online portal within two days. Citizens can also file through Bengaluru One, Karnataka One and Grama One centres.

stories.headline: DENSO IRIS WIN WOMEN’S BASKETBALL LEAGUE ASIA TITLE
stories.deck: Japan’s champions defeat Sichuan Yuanda Meile in the Bengaluru final

image.alt: Women's basketball final at Sree Kanteerava Indoor Stadium in Bengaluru
image.caption: The final was played at Sree Kanteerava Indoor Stadium.

paragraphs: Denso Iris won the Women’s Basketball League Asia title after the final at Sree Kanteerava Indoor Stadium on Sunday. Sichuan Yuanda Meile finished runners-up.
